note: Read 2026-10-31. Majority is each State's and Territory's own law; no Commonwealth Act sets one, so the country's majority is null and each is held in 'regions'. The Northern Territory: its Age of Majority Act 1974, s. 4 (reprint as in force at 1 April 1981, from the NT Legislation portal): a person attains full age for all purposes of the Territory's law at eighteen and is under no want of legal capacity by reason only of age. Tasmania: Age of Majority Act 1973 (Tasmanian Legislation Online, in force), s. 3: a person attaining eighteen on or after the appointed day attains full age and full capacity. The other Acts (NSW Minors (Property and Contracts) Act 1970; Victoria's Age of Majority Act 1977; Queensland's Law Reform Act 1995; South Australia's Age of Majority (Reduction) Act 1970; Western Australia's Age of Majority Act 1972; the ACT's Age of Majority Act 1974) weren't read and are held null (the blocker file names each attempt): NSW's and South Australia's legislation sites answered with a Cloudflare challenge, Victoria's and the ACT's pages gave no text to a plain request, Queensland's links weren't found. Work: null. There is no national minimum working age; each State and Territory sets its own (some none for most work, as New South Wales; others thirteen to fifteen, with permits for younger children), and child performers are licensed by the State (New South Wales's Office of the Children's Guardian, Victoria's Wage Inspectorate; none read). The form holds no regional work rule, so none is held; no State's text was read. Service: Service is held null: no source saying no service is asked was reached today (the blocker file names the attempts); a reading only, not held: the Defence Act 1903 allows a call-up only in time of war by proclamation, and the Australian Defence Force recruits volunteers (not read today).

sources.title: Age of Majority Act 1974 (Northern Territory), reprint as in force at 1 April 1981, NT Legislation
sources.said: Subject to this Act, a person attains full age for all purposes of the ... law of the Territory when he attains the age of 18 years.

sources.title: Age of Majority Act 1973 (Tasmania), Tasmanian Legislation Online, in force
sources.said: a person who, on or after the appointed day, attains the age of 18 years shall be deemed to attain full age and full capacity on attaining that age;
